failure: arm cannot track within torque/contact limits

provenance.servo_ratings: Default inferred from user-reported HiWonder SO-ARM101 kit; installed motor label and actual supply not verified. HX-30HM follower: 30 kgf cm, 0.19 s/60 degrees at 11.1 V, 1/345 gearing, 4096 encoder counts. Kit lists a 12 V supply; endpoints are not extrapolated. Sources: https://docs.hiwonder.com/projects/LeRobot/en/latest/docs/SO_ARM101_Open_Source_6_Axis_Robotic_Arm_User_Manual.html and https://www.hiwonder.com/products/hx-30hm . Feetech alternatives: https://docs.waveshare.com/ST3215_Servo .
provenance.arm_inertias: Existing upstream SO101 MJCF link mass and inertia values are retained through the wrist; obsolete stock gripper inertia is replaced.
provenance.body_mass_kg: Unmeasured estimates for the small printed assemblies. CAD-derived centers and normalized tensors are scaled to these masses.
provenance.contacts: Estimated rigid-body Coulomb friction and soft-contact compliance; printed-part flexure is not modeled.
provenance.servo_control: Estimated PID, communication delay, acceleration and I2t derating; not identified from hardware.
provenance.thread: Reduced helical force model for the existing 1 mm pitch plastic demonstration fastener, not an automotive lug nut.
provenance.latch: Breakable soft constraint for mechanical tool capture, enabled only after measured alignment, contact and jaw closure. Strength estimates need measurement.
provenance.layout: The separate wheel-release/nut-strip station is moved 0.15 m right in physics mode to clear the tire tool. Original CAD placements overlap. This is a proposed bench layout, not a measured hardware change.
provenance.continuous_torque: HX-30HM continuous torque is an unmeasured one-third-stall modeling allowance (0.980665 N m), not a manufacturer rating. Gains, thermal time constant, and derating require identification.
